blocks.content: The Object.keys() method retrieves all the keys from an object in one step.

items: retrieves all the keys in the book object.

blocks.content: This makes it much easier to see what information is available in an object.
But there's more—you can even use this method to count how many properties an object has. Let's explore that next.
